modules.name: UI/UX
modules.description: Effort targets for key user tasks in the Customer Support App for society management.

requirements.title: Log in with mobile number and OTP
requirements.description: All users log in with a mobile number and OTP, and the OTP is read automatically on Android.

requirements.title: Raise a complaint in 3 taps
requirements.description: A Resident must be able to raise a complaint in 3 taps and under 60 seconds.

requirements.title: Approve fixed complaint in 2 taps from notification
requirements.description: A Resident must be able to approve a fixed complaint in 2 taps, straight from the notification.

requirements.title: Approve a resident in 2 taps
requirements.description: A Society Manager must be able to approve a resident in 2 taps.

requirements.title: Check a complaint in 2 taps
requirements.description: A Society Manager must be able to check a complaint in 2 taps.

requirements.title: Book the hall in 4 taps
requirements.description: A Resident must be able to book the hall in 4 taps.

requirements.title: Visitor entry in 3 taps under 30 seconds
requirements.description: A Watchman must be able to record a visitor entry in 3 taps and under 30 seconds.

requirements.title: Assign a complaint in 2 clicks
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin must be able to assign a complaint in 2 clicks.

requirements.title: Learnable in under 5 minutes without training
requirements.description: Any new user must be able to learn the app in under 5 minutes with no training.

requirements.title: Add a family member in 3 taps
requirements.description: Adding a family member must take no more than 3 taps.

requirements.title: Check in to a facility in 1 tap
requirements.description: Checking in to a facility must take 1 tap.

requirements.title: Post a notice in under 1 minute
requirements.description: Posting a notice must take under 1 minute.

requirements.title: Family dashboard layout
requirements.description: The family dashboard shows counts as number cards on top and a bar per project split by age group, with the table below.
